shortBulletSummary: Binance resumes customer withdrawals after a $6.3 billion hack, with 95% of stolen assets reported as covered or replaced, and stabilization indicated despite net outflows.
Upcoming US midterm elections on November 3 may impact crypto regulations, with potential Democratic control complicating future legislation like the CLARITY Act.
US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs experienced substantial net outflows totaling $716 million on November 2, indicating cautious investor sentiment.
The broader crypto market shows signs of modest recovery and stabilization, with Bitcoin holding above $78,000 despite recent volatility and CeFi sector gains.
Rising US-Iran tensions and warnings of potential renewed military strikes ahead of the US midterms could impact global oil prices and financial markets, including crypto.
